GENERAL SCIENCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.

17. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.

20. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.

22. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution and Biodiversity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Skeletal and Muscular System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
